packageRules.description: Auto-merge patch + minor for trusted ecosystems; majors require human review
Major bumps land as draft MRs for review
Go module updates land grouped on Mondays to keep go.sum churn low
GitLab CI image bumps grouped similarly

Disable renovate for the hash-pinned Python docs toolchain — Renovate bumps the version line but cannot regenerate the SHA-256 hashes that `pip install --require-hashes` enforces, leaving CI broken. Bumps to requirements-lock.txt are handled manually via the recipe in the file's own header.
